typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeFXDHArchive_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		STP_NONSTP as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		Count as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		Month as string,
		Year as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeFXDHStaging
tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeFXDHStaging derive(TradeMonth = toString((Month + '-' + Year))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TradeMonth as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		STP_NONSTP as string,
		Count as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TradeMonth,
		Business_Group,
		Loaddate,
		STP_NONSTP,
		Count),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeFXDHArchive_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsSTPNonSTPVolumeFXDHArchive
